**VIEWINGS**

**AI CHAT ASSISTANT**

**Behaviour & Technical Specification**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Production method for accurate property Q&A, viewing conversion and agent escalation

**Decision this document supports**

Replace regex-first semantic routing with an LLM-led, tool-grounded architecture. Keep regex only for narrow deterministic validation. Every answer must be traceable to a verified source, and every CTA must follow the user's actual need.

| **Audience** | Syntax Erreur development, QA and product teams                             |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Status**   | Working specification for implementation and acceptance                     |
| **Version**  | 1.0 • 4 August 2026                                                         |
| **Inputs**   | Kenil's behavioural test report + Viewings AI assistant build specification |

**1 Purpose, scope and decision summary**

This specification defines how the Viewings conversational assistant must understand natural-language property enquiries, retrieve verified information, perform real actions, and guide users toward the next useful step. It is a behavioural contract and an implementation guide-not merely a prompt-writing document.

**Business objective**

**North-star outcome**

Help more users move from a property question to a confirmed viewing or meaningful agent contact-without sacrificing factual accuracy, compliance or user trust.

**In scope**

- **Single-listing chat:** questions about one property, viewing times, booking, cancellation and agent contact.
- **Agent-page chat:** questions about the agent, their listings, services and contact options.
- **Global Ask AI:** natural-language property discovery, comparisons and progression into a viewing.
- **Shared behaviour:** one orchestrator with context-specific data access and CTA priorities-not three separate chat systems.

**Required decisions**

| **LLM-led**<br><br>Use the model for intent, entities, context and response composition. | **Tool-grounded**<br><br>Use databases and APIs for facts, availability and actions. | **Measurable**<br><br>Accept the build only against a defined QA and conversion test suite. |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

**Non-goals for the first production release**

- A large multi-agent architecture for every property domain.
- Allowing the model to browse or invent neighbourhood, legal, financial or property facts.
- Using RAG as a substitute for live listing data, availability or booking APIs.
- Building a hard-coded regex branch for every way a user may phrase the same question.

**2 What current testing shows**

The issue is not isolated wording. The failure pattern points to a routing and grounding problem.

**Observed strengths**

- The current assistant sometimes interprets indirect wording correctly, including weekly rent, move-in timing, heating/cooling and some lifestyle questions.
- The existing regex/rule layer provides predictable responses for exact phrases and may remain useful for narrow deterministic tasks.
- The team has already connected parts of the chat experience to listing context and viewing functionality.

**Four decisive failure patterns**

| **User wording**                             | **Current behaviour**          | **Root problem**                                                  | **Required behaviour**                            |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| "Do I need to buy a bed?"                    | Returns bedroom count          | Understands keyword "bed," not the underlying furnishing need     | Map to furnished / included furniture             |
| "Can my dog play outside?"                   | Returns pets allowed           | Maps "dog" to pet policy, ignoring yard/fencing                   | Map to outdoor space + fencing + pet policy       |
| "Does the bedroom connect to the bathroom?"  | Returns room counts            | Retrieves related facts but not the requested layout relationship | Map to ensuite / attached bathroom                |
| "My father uses a wheelchair. Can he visit?" | Assumes access and shows slots | CTA fires before the accessibility question is verified           | Answer accessibility first; then use a gentle CTA |

**Root causes**

**Why adding more regex patterns will not solve this**

The system is often selecting a response from a related keyword rather than resolving the user's underlying intent. Adding more patterns can patch individual phrases, but it increases overlap, exceptions and maintenance while leaving context, mixed intent and unknown-data handling unsolved.

- **Semantic routing:** regex is being used for a language-understanding task.
- **Grounding:** the system can state a fact without confirming the field or approved source exists.
- **Context:** follow-ups, pronouns and intent changes are not reliably carried through the session.
- **Listing type:** rental policies can be applied to sales listings.
- **CTA sequencing:** actions can be promoted before the actual question is resolved.

**3 Core design principles**

| **1** | **Understand the underlying need**<br><br>Interpret meaning, indirect phrasing, multiple intents, typos and conversational follow-ups-not isolated keywords. |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| **2** | **Facts must be traceable**<br><br>Every property fact must point to structured data, an approved answer, an approved document or a successful tool result. |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **3** | **Separate language from truth**<br><br>The LLM understands and composes. Databases, business logic and tools remain the source of truth. |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **4** | **Answer before acting**<br><br>Resolve the user's question first. Then show the next relevant CTA, if one is appropriate. |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **5** | **Unknown is a valid result**<br><br>When data is unavailable, say so clearly, offer a real escalation path and log the miss. Never fill the gap with a plausible guess. |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| **6** | **Use one assistant across surfaces**<br><br>Listing, agent and global chat share the same orchestrator; context controls retrieval scope and CTA priority. |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

**Single governing rule**

Answer the user's underlying need from a known source-and never state a property fact that cannot be traced to that source.

**4 Target architecture and component responsibilities**

![Image: image1.png](data:image/png;base64,)

**Component ownership**

| **Component**              | **Responsibility**                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Frontend / surface context | Pass surface, property_id, listing_type, agent_id and session_id; render structured cards and action buttons.       |
| LLM orchestrator           | Classify intent, extract entities, map canonical attributes, select tools and compose a concise response.           |
| Structured data layer      | Return listing facts, property attributes, agent data and listing type. No free-text guessing.                      |
| Action tools               | Check availability, create/cancel bookings, send agent questions, capture contact and request callbacks.            |
| Approved knowledge / RAG   | Retrieve agency FAQs, property documents and approved lister content where structured fields are insufficient.      |
| Policy and validation      | Enforce listing-type rules, permissions, source precedence, PII handling, fair-treatment rules and tool validation. |
| Analytics / evaluation     | Log intent, attributes, source, tool calls, answer status, CTA, conversion and unresolved questions.                |

**Role of regex**

Regex remains useful, but only where exact pattern matching is the correct tool: phone and email detection, booking-reference validation, STOP/unsubscribe commands, basic spam/profanity checks and structured input validation. Regex must not decide the semantic meaning of property questions.

**5 Answer method: canonical attributes and intent resolution**

![Image: image2.png](data:image/png;base64,)

**Canonical property attributes**

The first semantic task is to map natural language onto one or more stable attributes. The attributes make routing, grounding, testing and analytics checkable.

| **Natural-language wording**                   | **Canonical attribute(s)**                |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| "Will I freeze?" / "Does it stay warm?"        | heating, insulation                       |
| "Do I need to buy a bed?" / "Is it set up?"    | furnished, included_furniture             |
| "Does the bedroom connect to the bathroom?"    | ensuite, bathroom_layout                  |
| "Can my dog play outside?"                     | outdoor_space, fencing, pets_policy       |
| "Can I work remotely?"                         | internet, fibre_status, workspace         |
| "Can my father visit in a wheelchair?"         | step_free_access, accessibility, lift     |
| "How much leaves my bank account each Friday?" | weekly_rent                               |
| "Can I celebrate New Year here?"               | available_from, viewing_or_move_in_intent |

**Structured extractor output**

{  
"intents": \["property_question"\],  
"attributes": \["outdoor_space", "fencing", "pets_policy"\],  
"entities": {"pet_type": "dog"},  
"listing_type": "rental",  
"confidence": 0.94,  
"requires_clarification": false  
}

**Important**

One question may map to several attributes. Do not force every message into exactly one field, and do not require the user to use the listing's terminology.

**6 Source routing, precedence and grounding policy**

**Routing table**

| **Question class**                                            | **Preferred source**                                      | **If present**                        | **If absent**                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Listing facts                                                 | Structured listing record                                 | State the verified value              | Say "not specified"; offer agent question where useful |
| Financial calculations                                        | Deterministic code using verified rental fields           | Calculate and show breakdown          | Do not estimate; identify missing field                |
| Heating, furnishing, ensuite, parking, outdoor, accessibility | Canonical attribute fields; then approved answer/document | Answer only the available attribute   | State what is missing; offer a real escalation         |
| Viewing availability                                          | Live calendar / availability API                          | Show current slots                    | Offer another date or notification                     |
| Booking / cancellation                                        | Validated booking API                                     | Confirm only after success            | Explain failure; preserve user input                   |
| Agent services / policies                                     | Approved agent content or RAG                             | Answer with approved content          | Offer agent contact                                    |
| Local amenities                                               | Verified local-data integration                           | Provide objective facts and distances | Say unavailable; do not guess                          |
| Subjective neighbourhood / seller intent                      | Approved, compliant lister answer only                    | Attribute the answer appropriately    | Decline to speculate; log question                     |

**Source precedence**

**Resolve conflicts using explicit priority**

Current structured record → current approved lister answer → approved property document → agent escalation. A newer verified source outranks older promotional prose. Tool outputs must include source and timestamp metadata.

**Answer status**

| **VERIFIED**<br><br>The source directly supports the statement. State it plainly. | **LIMITED**<br><br>The source supports a narrower statement. Explain the limitation. | **UNKNOWN**<br><br>No approved source. Say so and offer a real next step. |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

Example: a listing that shows air-conditioning but no heating data supports "The property has air-conditioning for cooling." It does not support "The property stays warm in winter."

**7 Context, memory and response contracts**

**Session context**

The assistant needs both a structured state object and recent conversation messages. Structured state carries stable facts; recent turns preserve conversational meaning, references and corrections.

{  
"session_id": "abc123",  
"surface": "listing",  
"property_id": "PROP-1042",  
"listing_type": "rental",  
"search_prefs": {"bedrooms": 3, "suburb": "Flat Bush"},  
"viewing_intent": {"date_iso": "2026-08-08", "window": "09:00-14:00"},  
"contact": {"captured": false},  
"last_topic": "parking"  
}

**State rules**

- Last stated value wins per field: if Saturday changes to Sunday, update the field rather than storing conflicting active preferences.
- Carry context across global search → listing page → booking flow.
- Pre-fill but never auto-commit a booking. The user must confirm.
- Use recent conversation turns for pronouns and follow-ups such as "Will my van fit?" or "What about the deposit?"
- Time-box stale preferences and confirm before reusing them in a later session.

**Structured response contract**

{  
"answer_status": "verified",  
"facts": \[{"attribute": "furnished", "value": false,  
"source": "listing_database", "source_id": "PROP-1042"}\],  
"text": "The property is listed as unfurnished, so you would need your own bed and furniture.",  
"actions": \[{"type": "view_available_times", "label": "View available times"}\]  
}

**8 Tools, actions and CTA behaviour**

**Minimum backend tool set**

| **Tool**                                            | **Required behaviour**                                             |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| get_property(property_id)                           | Return current structured facts and canonical attributes.          |
| search_listings(filters)                            | Return filtered listing summaries for global discovery.            |
| get_availability(property_id, date_range)           | Return real, bookable viewing slots.                               |
| create_booking(property_id, slot, contact)          | Create a booking after validation and user confirmation.           |
| cancel_booking(booking_id, user)                    | Cancel a valid booking and notify relevant parties.                |
| send_question_to_agent(thread_id, question)         | Create an actual agent/lister question and return delivery status. |
| request_callback(agent_id, contact, preferred_time) | Create a real callback task.                                       |
| capture_contact(contact, consent, source)           | Store contact details with purpose and consent metadata.           |

**CTA selection rules**

| **Conversation outcome** | **Primary CTA**                  |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| Property fact answered   | View available times             |
| Viewing enquiry          | Show live slots                  |
| Slot selected            | Confirm booking                  |
| No suitable slot         | Request another time / notify me |
| Information unavailable  | Ask the agent                    |
| Human contact requested  | Request callback / message agent |
| User browsing            | Save property                    |
| Booking completed        | Add to calendar / view booking   |

**Action integrity**

The assistant must never say "I sent it," "I booked it," or "the agent will call" unless the corresponding tool has succeeded. Before tool success, ask permission or explain the next step. After success, confirm the actual result.

**Response pattern**

| **1\. ANSWER**<br><br>Resolve the user's actual question first. | **2\. DETAIL**<br><br>Add only the verified detail that helps. | **3\. ACTION**<br><br>Offer one clear next step, not a CTA dump. |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |

**9 Worked chat examples and required behaviour**

| **Scenario**        | **User wording**                                     | **Grounding**                                      | **Required response**                                                                                                                                                                   | **CTA**              |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Furnishing          | User: "Do I need to buy a bed?"                      | Verified field: unfurnished                        | "The property is listed as unfurnished, so you would need your own bed and furniture. Would you like to see the available viewing times?"                                               | View available times |
| Outdoor suitability | User: "Can my dog play outside?"                     | Backyard present; fencing unknown; pets negotiable | "There is a private backyard, and pets are negotiable. The listing does not confirm whether the yard is fully fenced. Would you like me to ask the agent?"                              | Ask the agent        |
| Viewing             | User: "Can I see it Saturday morning?"               | Live slots: 9:00, 10:30, 11:30                     | "Yes-Saturday morning has 9:00, 10:30 and 11:30 available. Which time suits you?"                                                                                                       | Time buttons         |
| Accessibility       | User: "My father uses a wheelchair. Can he visit?"   | Step-free access not specified                     | "The listing does not confirm step-free or wheelchair access. I can send that question to the agent before you book."                                                                   | Ask the agent        |
| Sale pet question   | User: "Is this a pet-friendly place?"                | Listing type: sale; body corporate status unknown  | "Because this property is for sale, pet ownership would generally be your decision, subject to any body corporate or property restrictions. Those restrictions are not specified here." | Ask the agent        |
| Mixed intent        | User: "Tell me if pets are allowed and book Sunday." | Pets negotiable; Sunday slots available            | Answer pet status, show Sunday slots, capture contact, confirm only after tool success.                                                                                                 | Select Sunday slot   |

**Clarification policy**

Use answer-then-qualify when a useful verified fact is already available. Ask a clarification first only when the requested action or conclusion cannot be determined safely.

**Good clarification**

"The listing shows a two-car garage and one covered carport. Are you checking whether a larger vehicle or van will fit?"

**Unnecessary clarification**

Do not withhold the known parking capacity and ask "How many vehicles do you have?" unless the answer genuinely depends on that detail.

**10 Unknown information, knowledge improvement and compliance**

**Unanswered-question feedback loop**

- Log each unanswered question with property_id, resolved intent, canonical attributes, wording and frequency.
- Group semantically similar misses: "Is the yard fenced?" and "Can my dog safely play outside?" may contribute to the same fencing knowledge gap.
- Prompt the lister to add or approve an answer once, then make it available to future users.
- Retain answer provenance, approval status, author, timestamp and expiry/review date.
- Use recurring misses to expand the listing form, canonical attribute schema and QA test set.

**Commercial feature opportunity**

Pro plans may include richer FAQ analytics, proactive "most asked questions" prompts, image-assisted draft extraction and more approved custom answers. Basic truthfulness and safe unknown handling must not become paid-only behaviour.

**Compliance and safety rules**

| **Area**          | **Required rule**                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Fair treatment    | Do not screen, rank or steer users using protected or discriminatory characteristics. Avoid claims such as "best for families" or descriptions of the type of people who live nearby. |
| Subjective claims | Do not state "safe area," "friendly neighbours" or similar opinions as verified fact. Prefer objective amenities, distances and approved factual content.                             |
| PII and privacy   | Capture contact details deliberately, with purpose and retention rules. Do not reveal owner/tenant private details.                                                                   |
| Tool security     | Validate permissions, parameters, rate limits and booking availability server-side. The model cannot directly modify the database.                                                    |
| Auditability      | Store tool calls, source IDs, timestamps, response status and important actions for debugging and dispute resolution.                                                                 |
| Scope control     | Decline unrelated, private or unsafe requests and redirect to a useful property action where appropriate.                                                                             |

**n8n boundary**

Real-time session state must live in a fast store such as Redis or an equivalent service. n8n may handle asynchronous work after a decision: confirmation emails, agent notifications, CRM sync and follow-up sequences. It must not be the live conversational memory store.

**11 Delivery plan and release criteria**

**Implementation phases**

| **Phase**                             | **Scope**                                                                        | **Indicative effort** |
| ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| 0\. Contracts and state               | Define context, tool, source and response schemas; implement session read/write. | 3-5 dev-days          |
| 1\. Intent and attributes             | Structured extraction, canonical schema and Auckland date resolver.              | 4-6 dev-days          |
| 2\. Property Q&A grounding            | Source routing, listing-type rules, unknown handling and agent escalation.       | 5-8 dev-days          |
| 3\. Viewing actions                   | Availability, booking, cancellation, pre-fill and confirmation flow.             | 5-8 dev-days          |
| 4\. Global search and cards           | Natural-language filters, listing cards and cross-surface carry-over.            | 5-8 dev-days          |
| 5\. Guardrails and approved knowledge | Compliance, PII, documents/FAQ retrieval and source precedence.                  | 4-7 dev-days          |
| 6\. Evaluation and tuning             | Automated test harness, analytics, edge cases, latency and conversion tuning.    | 6-10 dev-days         |

Indicative total: approximately 32-52 dev-days if reliable listing, availability and booking APIs already exist. Any quote without confirming those dependencies is provisional.

**Minimum acceptance criteria**

| **Criterion**            | **Release threshold**                                             |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No fabrication           | Zero invented facts or completed actions in the agreed test set.  |
| Understanding            | ≥95% correct intent and canonical-attribute mapping.              |
| Action integrity         | All confirmed bookings validated; duplicates prevented.           |
| Business rules           | Correct listing type, date handling and source precedence.        |
| Conversation             | Context retained across follow-ups, pronouns and intent switches. |
| Conversion & reliability | Relevant CTA ≥95%; latency target and error budget agreed.        |

**Delivery ownership**

| **Owner**            | **Responsibility**                                                                         |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Product + QA         | Approve behaviour, CTA priorities, ground truth, test matrix and release criteria.         |
| Development team     | Implement contracts, orchestrator, tools, state, guardrails, logging and frontend actions. |
| Lister / agent users | Provide and approve missing property answers; keep source information current.             |
| Joint review         | Review failures, conversion drop-offs, unanswered questions and release readiness weekly.  |
